title: PBA: Adrian Nocum's big game not enough for ROS, rues late lapses

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Adrian Nocum’s career night was overshadowed by two turnovers that contributed to Rain or Shine’s Game 2 loss and enabled Converge to level their PBA Governors’ Cup quarterfinal series. Nocum dished out 18 assists on Friday, most of which came when the Elasto Painters made their run in the second half of the game held at Ninoy Aquino Stadium. But Nocum was quick to acknowledge that he was the guilty party in those pair of miscues that eventually set up Mikey Williams’ three-point shot that extended the FiberXers’ lead down to the final 35 seconds.
